data.narrative:
Skapion is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $36M to date, led by founders with deep domain expertise including former Rafael Air & Missile Defense leadership. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies across Defense & Security—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms spanning Seed through Series A, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $36M raised as a baseline and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $90M. Peer-Median analysis draws from 5 same-sector comparables at matching or adjacent stages, with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A), yielding a median of $1.0B. The dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage maturity and defensibility within the frontier-defense category.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a valuation range of $76M to $1.1B, with a median of $545M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around product maturity, revenue validation, and customer traction—data not provided in this analysis. The stage-progression method floors the range conservatively; peer multiples establish an upper bound but may overweight later-stage or higher-revenue comparables. Further diligence on go-to-market progress and defense-sector deployment timelines would narrow this band meaningfully.
